title: Dendritic aggregation of the postsynaptic cell adhesion molecule NGL-3 by pre-clustered antibodies to induce postsynaptic protein clustering
protocol: Transfect cultured hippocampal neurons at DIV 14 with EGFP-NGL-3.
Incubate transfected neurons for 2 days at 37°C.
Mix 1 μg of EGFP antibodies and 0.1 μg of FITC-conjugated secondary antibodies in a ratio of 10:1 in 500 μl complete neurobasal media (CNB).
Incubate the antibody mixture for 2 hours at 4°C.
Transfer DIV 16 transfected neurons to a 12-well plate containing ~400 μl prewarmed CNB per well.
Add 100 μl of preclustered antibody solution to achieve a final concentration of 400 ng/ml in each well.
Incubate the neurons for 1 hour at 37°C.
Wash the neurons three times with pre-warmed PBS.
Transfer the coverslip with neurons back to the conditioned culture media.
Fix and immunostain the neurons with primary antibodies against various postsynaptic proteins.
Add FITC-conjugated secondary antibodies during incubation of Cy3 secondary antibodies.
Capture Z-stacked images of the stained neurons by confocal microscopy.
Trace the boundaries of each NGL-3 cluster on dendrites.
Quantify the percentage of NGL-3 clusters that are positive for postsynaptic marker proteins.
Quantify the average immunofluorescence intensities of coclustered postsynaptic proteins.
Normalize the average immunofluorescence intensities to those in nearby dendrites.
